      const mod = await import('@huggingface/transformers');
fixes.reason: tsc reported the @ts-expect-error directive as unused (the dynamic import type-checked cleanly under the project tsconfig), so the directive was removed to avoid the TS2578 'unused @ts-expect-error' error.

fixes.after:
this.pipeline = ((task: string, model?: string, options?: Record<string, unknown>) =>
        mod.pipeline(task as never, model, options)) as unknown as PipelineFunction;
fixes.reason: mod.pipeline from @huggingface/transformers is typed as (task: PipelineType, ...) => Promise<Pipeline> with a string-literal-union/enum task argument, while AIEngine.PipelineFunction is a string-based callable. Wrapped the import in a thin adapter that maps the local string task to the library's expected type (cast as never to bypass the enum narrowing) and re-casts the result back to the locally-declared PipelineFunction. Preserves the existing call sites (this.pipeline!('text-classification', ...), etc.) without changing downstream code.
